question.text: Using the textbook example with a net portfolio value of Rs. 113.876 lakh on a capital contribution of Rs. 100 lakh, the net return on the client's investment is approximately:

explanation.text: The Logic: Net return = (Net value − Capital) / Capital = (113.876 − 100) / 100 = 13.876%, which rounds to 13.88%. The Trap: 20.00% reflects the gross return before fees and is the most common confusion. 15.00% and 18.50% do not correspond to the textbook example's net-of-fees figure. Note: Stem rewritten to be standalone (no "above client" reference) by stating the textbook case data explicitly; pro-tip and cross-exam framing removed.
